subject: MAP: Draft share + slide ownership grid
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Draft share + slide ownership grid

Hi Lara —

Following our discovery yesterday, I put together a lightweight MAP template and a short slide skeleton to capture stakeholders, milestones, and quick acceptance criteria. Attaching both as stubs and also sharing a live doc so we can co-edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-map-draft

Ask from our side: can you confirm the core stakeholder group and who will own data/security approvals on your side? If you prefer, I can populate the first draft with the names you gave on the call:

- Week 0: Technical scoping (owner: Acme eng lead)
- Week 1: Pilot integration + test prompts (owner: Redwood eng)
- Week 2: Evaluation and metrics review (owner: Acme product)
- Week 3: Acceptance and go/no-go decision (owner: Acme success)

Attached: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (editable), MAP-slide-skeleton.pptx (5 slides)

Next steps I recommend:
1) You drop in stakeholder names in the doc by EOD Friday.
2) We schedule a 30-min coauthor session early next week to align owners and success metrics.

Ben / Naomi / Marissa — marking you for help on the slide owners and to draft the evaluation metrics section (Naomi can lead).

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for sending this over — the structure looks good and I appreciate the lean slide skeleton. Quick answers below:

- Stakeholders: Lara Gomez (Product Lead), Raj Patel (Security), Maria Torres (Data Eng), Kevin Wu (CTO for approvals)
- Security/data owner: Raj Patel (raj.patel@acmehealth.com)
- Procurement will need a draft SOW and an estimated cost sheet — looping them on this thread (procurement@acmehealth.com).

I dropped a few comments in the doc on acceptance metrics. We should keep the pilot limited to a whitelist of 2–3 care pathways initially.

I can do the coauthor session on Monday between 9–11 PT — does that work for your team?

Regards,

Lara Gomez

Thanks, Lara — this is helpful. I pulled Lara's stakeholder list into the MAP and added an "Evaluation metrics" tab with suggested KPIs:

- Latency (95th pct) for API responses under test workload
- Token cost per transaction (pilot baseline vs optimized)
- Precision on entity extraction for clinical notes (sample set of 200)
- Uptime / availability during the week-long run

Ben and Marissa: can you two take slide ownership? I sketched slide assignments in the attached PPT (MAP-slide-skeleton.pptx):
- Slide 1: Executive summary / outcomes (Marissa)
- Slide 2: Pilot scope & timeline (Ben)
- Slide 3: Success metrics & evaluation plan (Naomi)
- Slide 4: Risk & mitigations (Ben)
- Slide 5: Next steps / meeting cadence (Marissa)

I booked the coauthor session for Monday 10:00–10:30 PT and shared a calendar invite — if that time doesn't work, say so and I'll move it. Also adding a short procurement attachment template in the doc (placeholder) so Acme procurement has a draft SOW to start with.

Naomi Feldman
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
